spec.title: HTTP Client
spec.description: Requests sent by the application to other services, by server, status, and duration, following the Micrometer conventions, the Spring Boot default.

spec.name: instance
spec.label: Instance
spec.description: Application instances, from the most recently started.

spec.title: Requests
spec.description: Requests sent in the selected time range.

spec.title: Failure Rate
spec.description: Share of the requests that got an error response (4xx or 5xx) or no response at all in the selected time range.

spec.expr: (sum(increase(http_client_requests_seconds_count{job="$job", instance="$instance", client_name=~"$target", status!~"[123].."}[$__range])) or vector(0)) / sum(increase(http_client_requests_seconds_count{job="$job", instance="$instance", client_name=~"$target"}[$__range]))

spec.title: Failed Requests
spec.description: Requests that got an error response (4xx or 5xx) or no response at all in the selected time range.

spec.title: Average Duration
spec.description: Average duration of the requests in the selected time range.

spec.title: Longest Request
spec.description: Duration of the longest request in the selected time range.

spec.title: Active Requests
spec.description: Requests in progress right now, for all servers.

spec.title: Servers
spec.description: Requests, failure rate, and durations by server in the selected time range. Select a column header to sort.

spec.expr: (sum by (client_name) (label_replace(increase(http_client_requests_seconds_count{job="$job", instance="$instance", client_name=~"$target", status!~"[123].."}[$__range]), "client_name", "UNKNOWN", "client_name", "")) or sum by (client_name) (label_replace(increase(http_client_requests_seconds_count{job="$job", instance="$instance", client_name=~"$target"}[$__range]), "client_name", "UNKNOWN", "client_name", "")) * 0) / sum by (client_name) (label_replace(increase(http_client_requests_seconds_count{job="$job", instance="$instance", client_name=~"$target"}[$__range]), "client_name", "UNKNOWN", "client_name", ""))

sum by (client_name) (label_replace(increase(http_client_requests_seconds_sum{job="$job", instance="$instance", client_name=~"$target"}[$__range]), "client_name", "UNKNOWN", "client_name", "")) / sum by (client_name) (label_replace(increase(http_client_requests_seconds_count{job="$job", instance="$instance", client_name=~"$target"}[$__range]), "client_name", "UNKNOWN", "client_name", ""))

spec.title: Requests by Status
spec.description: Requests per second, by class of status code. *No response* counts the requests that failed before getting one.

spec.title: Failed Requests
spec.description: Failed requests per second, by server and status code. Requests without a response have no status code.

spec.expr: sum by (client_name, status) (label_replace(rate(http_client_requests_seconds_count{job="$job", instance="$instance", client_name=~"$target", status!~"[123].."}[$__rate_interval]), "client_name", "UNKNOWN", "client_name", ""))

spec.title: Failure Rate
spec.description: Share of the requests that failed, by server.

spec.expr: sum by (client_name) (label_replace(rate(http_client_requests_seconds_count{job="$job", instance="$instance", client_name=~"$target", status!~"[123].."}[$__rate_interval]), "client_name", "UNKNOWN", "client_name", "")) / sum by (client_name) (label_replace(rate(http_client_requests_seconds_count{job="$job", instance="$instance", client_name=~"$target"}[$__rate_interval]), "client_name", "UNKNOWN", "client_name", ""))

sum by (client_name) (label_replace(rate(http_client_requests_seconds_sum{job="$job", instance="$instance", client_name=~"$target"}[$__rate_interval]), "client_name", "UNKNOWN", "client_name", "")) / sum by (client_name) (label_replace(rate(http_client_requests_seconds_count{job="$job", instance="$instance", client_name=~"$target"}[$__rate_interval]), "client_name", "UNKNOWN", "client_name", ""))

spec.title: Longest Request
spec.description: Duration of the longest request, by server.

spec.title: Failed Requests
spec.description: The most recent requests that got an error response (4xx or 5xx). Select a span to see its trace.
